item.text: I’ll inspect the OS detection and EOL code plus the existing tests, write the required checkpoint, then make the smallest repository change and run the relevant existing tests.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: add Amazon Linux release detection and EOL mappings for versions 2023, 2025, 2027, and 2029, preserving existing behavior and supporting correct standard/extended support end-date evaluation.

Progress: repository inspection started; next locate implementation and existing tests, then edit and run relevant existing tests.
EOF
find . -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './vendor/*' | head -200"

item.text:
Amazon Linux detection now recognizes releases 2023, 2025, 2027, and 2029. `YYYY.MM` releases still normalize to `1`, and unrecognized releases return `unknown`, so `GetEOL` reports `found=false` for them.

Added standard support dates: 2023 → 2029-06-30, 2025 → 2031-06-30, 2027 → 2033-06-30, and 2029 → 2035-06-30. System release parsing now handles the newer Amazon Linux banners.

`go test ./config ./scanner` passed. Updates are in [config/os.go](/app/config/os.go) and [redhatbase.go](/app/scanner/redhatbase.go).
